title: SchemaVersion
description: Canonical wire form of choirloom::score::SchemaVersion - strict 'major.minor.patch' with non-negative uint32-like components, no leading zeros (except 0), exactly three segments, no prerelease/build metadata. Distinct nominal concept (never a ProjectRevision/ModelVersion/ApplicationVersion/Git SHA/SQLite store-schema version). DRAFT / NON-FROZEN. Two-level validation: this schema enforces the syntactic pattern only; exact uint32 range is enforced by the core (SchemaVersion::from_string).
